faq.question: Q1. What is Udupi Cochin Shipyard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited has released a recruitment notification to fill 2 Supervisory posts (Supervisor Nesting and Supervisor Mechanical) on a regular roll at Malpe, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 for Supervisor (Nesting) and 1 for Supervisor (Mechanical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for UCSL Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 09 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Diploma in relevant engineering branches (Mechanical, Electrical, Marine, Civil, Electronics & Communication, Computer, or Automobile Engineering) from a State Board of Technical Education.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Udupi Cochin Shipyard Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 28 October 2026, relaxable for ST candidates and Ex-servicemen as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 400/- for unreserved candidates, while SC and ST candidates are fully exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale for Udupi CSL Supervisor positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in the S1 grade pay scale of ₹ 28000-3%-110000, with total monthly emoluments amounting to approximately ₹ 56,896.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written examination for selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selection includes Phase I consisting of an offline objective test (40 marks) and a descriptive test (40 marks), followed by Phase II consisting of a PowerPoint presentation on work experience (20 marks).
